# oss-maintainer-review

> Triage an incoming OSS pull request as its maintainer before running contributor code. Review GitHub Actions trust boundaries, supply-chain and client execution risks, design claims, and public contribution history to decide whether to test the reviewed revision.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install mizchi/skills/oss-maintainer-review
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml
dependencies:
  apm:
    - mizchi/skills/oss-maintainer-review
```

then run `apm install`.

`SKILL.md` folder that works with Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI,
Cursor, and other [compatible agents](https://agentskills.io/clients).
